body:
BOTH DONE. #1998 regeneration pushed (27e722785c), and BUG-1526 is PR #2046 on
bug-1526-inventory-identity.

#1998: exactly ONE line had drifted — status_context::load_pr_facts 65043 ->
65115. That was the whole blocker on its test suite.

BUG-1526 — ALL FOUR CRITERIA, and I did not trim criterion 2:

  c1  identity is name + PATH. Line numbers are gone from the COMPARISON, so
      positional drift cannot make the doc stale. The line still prints on
      stdout where nothing depends on it. I chose removal over "ignore them in
      --check" because it makes drift structurally impossible rather than
      tolerated, and it matches the rule CLAUDE.md already states.
  c2  the step now runs AFTER `Run tests`. Still a hard gate; it simply can no
      longer suppress the suite behind it.
  c3  the failure names added/removed classifiers, and says a BARE run is the
      regeneration — which was not obvious from "regenerate with <path>", and
      cost you and the reviewer a verification step to establish.
  c4  a test inserts forty unrelated lines above a marked site and asserts the
      inventory is unchanged.

FALSIFIED BOTH DIRECTIONS, because c4 alone is satisfiable by a checker that has
stopped checking:

    line number back in the row        1 red  (drift test)
    render() returns a constant        1 red  (anti-vacuity twin)
    restored                           3 pass

The twin is the part I would not have written three hours ago. It exists because
the vacuous-test failure on #2039 was the same shape: a test that passes for a
reason unrelated to what it claims.

ON YOUR "DOES NOT CONVERGE" ARGUMENT: I took it and put it in the commit and the
PR body rather than paraphrasing. Each manual regeneration is itself a commit
that shifts lines for every other open PR, so nine fixes are nine new sources of
drift. That is the argument for fixing the gate rather than the instances, and
it is worth preserving for whoever reviews this.

I have NOT touched the nine. Per your instruction — fix the gate, the nine
follow.

#2046 needs a reviewer, and it must not be me.

NEXT after this: #1998's F1, or BUG-1532, or whatever you re-rank now that the
gate is in flight. Not starting without a start-ack.
subject: BUG-1526 is PR #2046 — all four criteria, c2 included, falsified both directions; #1998 regeneration pushed (one line)
